warmups.name: Push-Up Plus
warmups.precautions: Body in one straight line head-to-heels - hips not sagging or piked (unless Pike);Hands under shoulders, fingers spread;Head neutral - look at floor, not forward
warmups.cues: Body in one straight line;Hands under shoulders;Lower with control, press up

warmups.name: Light Push-ups
warmups.precautions: Body in one straight line head-to-heels - hips not sagging or piked (unless Pike);Hands under shoulders, fingers spread;Head neutral - look at floor, not forward
warmups.cues: Body in one straight line;Hands under shoulders;Lower with control, press up

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
exercises.precautions: Your back stays flat on the bench (or floor), not arched hard;Feet flat on the floor, planted and still;Wrists straight, in line with your forearms;Only your arms move - shoulders stay down away from ears
exercises.cues: Feet flat, back on pad;Push handles forward smoothly;Lower slowly to chest stretch

exercises.name: Incline DB Press
exercises.precautions: Your back stays flat on the bench (or floor), not arched hard;Feet flat on the floor, planted and still;Wrists straight, in line with your forearms;Only your arms move - shoulders stay down away from ears
exercises.cues: Set up tall with good posture;Move slowly and with control;Breathe out on the hard part

exercises.name: KB Floor Press
exercises.precautions: Your back stays flat on the bench (or floor), not arched hard;Feet flat on the floor, planted and still;Wrists straight, in line with your forearms;Only your arms move - shoulders stay down away from ears
exercises.cues: Upper arms rest lightly on floor;Press up until arms straight;Lower slowly and controlled

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.precautions: Body in one straight line head-to-heels - hips not sagging or piked (unless Pike);Hands under shoulders, fingers spread;Head neutral - look at floor, not forward;Only arms bend - torso stays rigid like a plank
exercises.cues: Body in one straight line;Hands under shoulders;Lower with control, press up

exercises.name: Cable Fly
exercises.precautions: Back tall, chest up - shoulders down and back;Soft bend in elbows that stays fixed the whole set;Stagger stance for balance, torso still;Hands meet in front of chest, not below it
exercises.cues: Handles at shoulder height;Sweep hands together wide;Slowly open back to a stretch

exercises.name: DB Chest Fly
exercises.precautions: Entire back flat on bench, feet planted;Soft bend in elbows that stays fixed;Lower only until elbows level with bench - no deeper;Wrists straight over elbows, palms facing each other
exercises.cues: Start dumbbells over chest;Open wide with control;Squeeze chest to bring them back

exercises.name: Assisted Dip (Chest)
exercises.precautions: Torso leans slightly forward (chest dip angle);Elbows point back-out at ~45 degrees;Shoulders down away from ears the whole time;Lower only to a comfortable stretch - never force depth
exercises.cues: Set assist, grip bars firmly;Lower with control;Press up without locking elbows

stretches.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it
